احتشوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَوْا (iḥtašaw) /iħ.ta.ʃaw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اُحْتُشُوا (uḥtušū) /uħ.tu.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اِحْتَشُوا (iḥtašū) /iħ.ta.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
